description: This file defines configuration structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes for the RdkEasyMeshController component, including profile management, callback registration, and configuration retrieval.

methods.name: map_cfg_fini
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the configuration system.

methods.name: map_cfg_set_cbs
methods.description: Sets callback functions for configuration updates.

methods.name: map_cfg_load
methods.description: Loads configuration from a specified version.

methods.name: map_cfg_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is enabled.

methods.name: map_cfg_set_master_state
methods.description: Sets the master state of the device.

methods.name: map_profile_get_by_sidx
methods.description: Retrieves a profile by its index.

methods.name: map_profile_save
methods.description: Saves a profile to persistent storage.

methods.name: map_profile_clone
methods.description: Clones profile data from source to destination.
